# Datamarcos

> Datamarcos is a technology learning company based in Noida, India. It runs live, mentor-led online courses in AI and data engineering for students and working professionals, taught by founder Deepesh Mishra, and also trains teams at organizations. Placement support, not a job guarantee.

## Flagship courses (live online, mentor-led)

- [Forward Deployed AI Engineer](https://www.datamarcos.com/programs/forward-deployed-ai-engineer): 22 weeks for working engineers. Scope, build, secure and deploy production AI (RAG, agents, MCP, LLMOps) through four client-style engagements, from customer discovery to handover.
- [Generative AI & Agentic AI Engineer](https://www.datamarcos.com/programs/genai-agentic-ai-engineer): 18 weeks. Build, evaluate, secure and deploy GenAI and agentic AI systems, with three client-style projects and a capstone.
- [Applied Agentic AI Certification](https://www.datamarcos.com/programs/applied-agentic-ai-certification): 8 weeks, no prior AI experience needed. RAG, tool-using agents, multi-agent workflows and automation, with a project every module and a capstone.
- [Advance Data Engineering with Applied GenAI & Agentic AI](https://www.datamarcos.com/programs/advance-data-engineering-genai): a four-month cloud data engineering foundation (Python, SQL, Azure, PySpark, Databricks, streaming), then an advanced track in RAG, agents and an integrated capstone.
- [All programs](https://www.datamarcos.com/programs)
